summary:
• Gemini 4 Neon — Google DeepMind’s multimodal model that handles engineering, knowledge work, and scientific analysis in a single pass, enabling unified workflows with massive context and low hallucination.
• Claude Code — Anthropic’s coding assistant for macOS and Linux integrates into IDEs, offering enterprise sign‑in, on‑demand charting, and self‑hosted execution for secure, visual code reviews.
• Gezhi‑Sheets — An open‑source spreadsheet add‑on that lets users select rows, have an LLM categorize demand and write concise summaries, preserving full Excel functionality.
• Hebbia’s Matrix — Hebbia’s AI tool now runs on OpenAI’s GPT‑6 Astra to extract source documents and auto‑generate PowerPoint decks, delivering traceable citations for high‑value banking decisions.
• MedChemBench — MedChemBench evaluates models on reading molecular structures, interpreting assay results, and prioritizing compounds, revealing gaps between property prediction and real drug‑discovery decisions.
• METR’s updated time‑horizon plot — METR’s visualization tracks how quickly AI models extend task lengths, showing continued exponential gains for verifiable tasks but slower progress on judgment‑heavy work.
